🛠 Shutdown = Update! 🛠
🦖 Welcome to Jurassic Farm! 🦕

⭐ HOW TO PLAY

Buy Dinosaurs 🦖
Dinosaurs drop Eggs over time 🥚
Collect and deposit Eggs to earn Money 💰
Use Money to buy more Dinosaurs 💵
Merge Dinosaurs to get higher-tier Dinosaurs 🦕
Higher-tier Dinosaurs drop even more Eggs 🥚
Unlock new Dinosaurs and expand your Jurassic collection! ⭐

👍 Like & Favorite for more updates!
